Metadata.Goal: Reduce unsupported bash approval noise with deterministic low-risk readonly fallback.
Metadata.Description: Classify parser-unsupported bash commands by risk before asking for human approval.

TaskSpace.name: add-bash-risk-fallback
TaskSpace.Description: Add deterministic risk fallback for parser-unsupported bash commands.

TaskGroup.name: Fallback tests
TaskGroup.Description: Add failing tests for low-risk readonly unsupported commands and dangerous unsupported commands.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Tests distinguish low-risk readonly, dangerous, protected-config, and unknown commands.

Task.name: Add unsupported fallback tests
Task.Description: Extend local permission evaluator tests with session-derived unsupported command samples.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Readonly command substitution sample is allowed when no rule matches.
Dangerous unsupported command is not silently allowed.
Protected permission config reference remains blocked.

TaskGroup.name: Fallback implementation
TaskGroup.Description: Implement explicit risk classifier for unsupported bash syntax.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Unsupported high-risk commands still ask or deny.

Task.name: Implement risk classifier
Task.Description: Add low-risk readonly fallback below protected config checks and above generic ask.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Low-risk readonly unsupported commands return allow.
Unknown unsupported commands still return ask.

TaskGroup.name: Verification
TaskGroup.Description: Run targeted local permission evaluator tests and update mission report.

Task.name: Run targeted test
Task.Description: Run permission evaluator tests after fallback implementation.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Targeted local permission evaluator tests pass.
